mapper.select: SELECT center_code AS centerCode, dead_line_at AS deadlineAt FROM erp_order_deadline
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_order_deadline SET dead_line_at = #{deadlineAt}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE center_code = #{centerCode}
mapper.select: SELECT center_code AS centerCode, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 'unchecked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitCount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 'unchecked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(0 AS BIT) ELSE CAST(1 AS BIT) END AS confirmed FROM erp_reorder WHERE yy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} GROUP BY center_code

SELECT r.id AS id, r.reorder_type AS state, u.user_name AS userName, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, r.count AS cnt, r.confirmed AS confirmed, r.center_code AS centerCode, CONVERT(VARCHAR (19), r.created_at, 120) AS createdAt, r.reason AS reason FROM erp_reorder r JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN r.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(r.class_key, 2, LEN(r.class_key)) ELSE r.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON r.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON r.user_code = u.user_code WHERE r.yy = #{year} AND r.mm = #{month} AND r.center_code = #{centerCode}
AND r.confirmed = 'unchecked'

SELECT center_name AS centerName, biz_no AS bizNum, director_name AS directorName, center_address AS address, manager_name AS managerName, manager_tel AS managerTel FROM erp_center WHERE center_code = #{centerCode}

SELECT o.class_name, o.unit_name, o.baseCount, 0 as teacherCount, o.reorderCount, o.baseCount + o.reorderCount AS totalCount, ISNULL(s.studentCount, 0) AS timeTableCount FROM (SELECT class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId, SUM(baseCount) AS baseCount, SUM(reorderCount) AS reorderCount FROM (SELECT cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id AS ucId, SUM(o.total_count) AS baseCount, 0 AS reorderCount FROM erp_order o JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN o.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(o.class_key, 2, LEN(o.class_key)) ELSE o.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON o.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE o.yy = #{year} AND o.mm = #{month} AND o.center_code != 'PUS001' GROUP BY cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id
UNION ALL
SELECT cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id, 0, SUM (CASE WHEN r.reorder_type = 'ADD' THEN r.count WHEN r.reorder_type = 'RETURN' THEN -r.count ELSE 0 END) FROM erp_reorder r JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN r.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING (r.class_key, 2, LEN(r.class_key)) ELSE r.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON r.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE r.yy = #{year} AND r.mm = #{month} AND r.center_code != 'PUS001' AND r.confirmed = 'checked' GROUP BY cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id) AS order_sub GROUP BY class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId) AS o LEFT JOIN (SELECT class_name, unit_name, SUM(cnt) AS studentCount FROM (SELECT cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id AS ucId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN t.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(t.class_key, 2, LEN(t.class_key)) ELSE t.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON t.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND t.center_code != 'PUS001' GROUP BY t.time_table_key, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, uc.id) AS tt_sub GROUP BY class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId) AS s ON o.class_name = s.class_name AND o.unit_name = s.unit_name ORDER BY o.class_type, CASE o.class_key WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'P' THEN 3 WHEN 'ES' THEN 4 WHEN 'EP' THEN 5 WHEN 'EG' THEN 6 WHEN 'ED' THEN 7 WHEN 'HSN' THEN 8 WHEN 'HSU' THEN 9 WHEN 'HSX' THEN 10 WHEN 'HSS' THEN 11 WHEN 'HSA' THEN 12 WHEN 'K' THEN 13 WHEN 'M' THEN 14 WHEN 'J' THEN 15 WHEN 'SU' THEN 16 WHEN 'DU' THEN 17 WHEN 'TU' THEN 18 WHEN 'BSN' THEN 19 WHEN 'BSU' THEN 20 WHEN 'BSX' THEN 21 WHEN 'BSS' THEN 22 END, o.ucId

SELECT o.class_name, o.unit_name, o.baseCount, 0 as teacherCount, o.reorderCount, o.baseCount + o.reorderCount AS totalCount, ISNULL(s.studentCount, 0) AS timeTableCount FROM (SELECT class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId, SUM(baseCount) AS baseCount, SUM(reorderCount) AS reorderCount FROM (SELECT cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id AS ucId, SUM(o.total_count) AS baseCount, 0 AS reorderCount FROM erp_order o JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN o.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(o.class_key, 2, LEN(o.class_key)) ELSE o.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON o.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE o.yy = #{year} AND o.mm = #{month} AND o.center_code = #{centerCode} GROUP BY cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id
UNION ALL
SELECT cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reorder_type = 'ADD' THEN r.count WHEN r.reorder_type = 'RETURN' THEN -r.count ELSE 0 END) FROM erp_reorder r JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN r.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(r.class_key, 2, LEN(r.class_key)) ELSE r.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON r.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE r.yy = #{year} AND r.mm = #{month} AND r.center_code = #{centerCode} AND r.confirmed = 'checked' GROUP BY cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id) AS order_sub GROUP BY class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId) AS o LEFT JOIN (SELECT class_name, unit_name, SUM(cnt) AS studentCount FROM (SELECT cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id AS ucId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN t.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(t.class_key, 2, LEN(t.class_key)) ELSE t.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON t.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND t.center_code = #{centerCode} GROUP BY t.time_table_key, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, uc.id) AS tt_sub GROUP BY class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId) AS s ON o.class_name = s.class_name AND o.unit_name = s.unit_name ORDER BY o.class_type, CASE o.class_key WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'P' THEN 3 WHEN 'ES' THEN 4 WHEN 'EP' THEN 5 WHEN 'EG' THEN 6 WHEN 'ED' THEN 7 WHEN 'HSN' THEN 8 WHEN 'HSU' THEN 9 WHEN 'HSX' THEN 10 WHEN 'HSS' THEN 11 WHEN 'HSA' THEN 12 WHEN 'K' THEN 13 WHEN 'M' THEN 14 WHEN 'J' THEN 15 WHEN 'SU' THEN 16 WHEN 'DU' THEN 17 WHEN 'TU' THEN 18 WHEN 'BSN' THEN 19 WHEN 'BSU' THEN 20 WHEN 'BSX' THEN 21 WHEN 'BSS' THEN 22 END, o.ucId

SELECT o.user_name AS userName, o.user_code AS userCode, o.class_name, o.unit_name, o.baseCount, 0 AS teacherCount, o.reorderCount, o.baseCount + o.reorderCount AS totalCount, ISNULL(s.studentCount, 0) AS timeTableCount FROM (SELECT user_name, user_code, class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId, SUM(baseCount) AS baseCount, SUM(reorderCount) AS reorderCount FROM (SELECT u.user_name, o.user_code, cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id AS ucId, SUM(o.total_count) AS baseCount, 0 AS reorderCount FROM erp_order o JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN o.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(o.class_key, 2, LEN(o.class_key)) ELSE o.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON o.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON o.user_code = u.user_code WHERE o.yy = #{year} AND o.mm = #{month} AND o.center_code = #{centerCode} GROUP BY u.user_name, o.user_code, cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id
UNION ALL
SELECT u.user_name, r.user_code, cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reorder_type = 'ADD' THEN r.count WHEN r.reorder_type = 'RETURN' THEN -r.count ELSE 0 END) FROM erp_reorder r JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN r.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(r.class_key, 2, LEN(r.class_key)) ELSE r.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON r.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON r.user_code = u.user_code WHERE r.yy = #{year} AND r.mm = #{month} AND r.center_code = #{centerCode} AND r.confirmed = 'checked' GROUP BY u.user_name, r.user_code, cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id) AS order_sub GROUP BY user_name, user_code, class_name, unit_name, class_type, class_key, ucId) AS o LEFT JOIN (SELECT u.user_name, tt_sub.class_name, tt_sub.unit_name, tt_sub.class_type, tt_sub.class_key, tt_sub.ucId, SUM(tt_sub.cnt) AS studentCount FROM (SELECT t.user_code, cc.class_name, uc.unit_name, cc.class_type, cc.class_key, uc.id AS ucId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN t.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(t.class_key, 2, LEN(t.class_key)) ELSE t.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON t.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND tt_sub.class_name, tt_sub.unit_name, tt_sub.class_type, tt_sub.class_key, tt_sub.ucId) AS s ON o.user_name = s.user_name AND o.class_name = s.class_name AND o.unit_name = s.unit_name ORDER BY 'HSX' THEN 10 WHEN 'HSS' THEN 11 WHEN 'HSA' THEN 12 WHEN 'K' THEN 13 WHEN 'M' THEN 14 WHEN 'J' THEN 15 WHEN 'SU' THEN 16 WHEN 'DU' THEN 17 WHEN 'TU' THEN 18 WHEN 'BSN' THEN 19 WHEN 'BSU' THEN 20 WHEN 'BSX' THEN 21 WHEN 'BSS' THEN 22 END, o.ucId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_order_manual (yy, mm, title, center_code, writer_name, total_amount, manual_id, created_at) VALUES (#{dto.yy}, #{dto.mm}, #{dto.title}, #{dto.centerCode}, #{dto.writerName}, #{dto.totalAmount}, #{manualId}, GETDATE())

INSERT INTO erp_order_manual_item (manual_id, order_date, class_key, unit_key, qty, price, amount, note, approve_date, created_at) VALUES (#{manualId}, #{item.orderDate}, #{item.classKey}, #{item.unitKey}, #{item.qty}, #{item.price}, #{item.amount}, #{item.note}, #{item.approveDate}, GETDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT m.manual_id AS manualId, m.title AS title, m.yy AS yy, m.mm AS mm, m.total_amount AS totalAmount, COUNT(i.id) AS itemCount FROM erp_order_manual m LEFT JOIN erp_order_manual_item i ON i.manual_id = m.manual_id WHERE m.yy = #{year} AND m.mm = #{month} AND m.center_code = #{centerCode} GROUP BY m.manual_id, m.title, m.yy, m.mm, m.total_amount, m.id ORDER BY m.id

SELECT order_date AS orderDate, class_key AS classKey, unit_key AS unitKey, qty AS qty, price AS price, amount AS amount, note AS note, approve_date AS approveDate FROM erp_order_manual_item WHERE manual_id = #{manualId} ORDER BY id
SELECT class_key AS classKey, class_name AS className FROM erp_class_code ORDER BY class_type
SELECT m.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_class_unit_map m JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON m.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE m.class_key = #{classKey} ORDER BY m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_reorder (reorder_type, user_code, class_key, unit_key, count, confirmed, center_code, yy, mm, reason, created_at, sugi) VALUES ('ADD', #{item.userCode}, #{item.classKey}, #{item.unitKey}, #{item.qty}, 'checked', #{centerCode}, #{year}, #{month}, #{item.reason}, GETDATE(), 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT manual_id AS manualId, title AS title, yy AS yy, mm AS mm, center_code AS centerCode, writer_name AS writerName, total_amount AS totalAmount FROM erp_order_manual WHERE manual_id = #{manualId}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_order_manual SET total_amount = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TRY_CAST(NULLIF(amount, '') AS INT)) FROM erp_order_manual_item WHERE manual_id = #{manualId}), 0), updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE manual_id = #{manualId}
mapper.select: SELECT class_key AS classKey, unit_key AS unitKey, count AS qty, user_code AS userCode, reason AS reason FROM erp_reorder WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND yy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND sugi = 'Y' ORDER BY id

SELECT h.round AS round, CONVERT(VARCHAR (19), h.created_at, 120) AS orderDate, h.class_key AS classKey, cc.class_name AS className, h.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName, h.count AS count, up.unit_price AS unitPrice, h.count * ISNULL(up.unit_price, 0) AS totalPrice FROM erp_order_history h JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN h.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(h.class_key, 2, LEN(h.class_key)) ELSE h.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON h.unit_key = uc.unit_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_price up ON h.class_key = up.class_key WHERE h.center_code = #{centerCode} AND h.user_code = #{userCode} AND h.yy = #{year} AND h.mm = #{month} ORDER BY h.round, cc.id, uc.id
